question: RXPL is related to OUMI in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, TZRN is related to QWOK. To which of the following is PVNJ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/357e1c1d99f4326c1e89285fe50f3ccf50b1cdc600d08b67740d67cc1e091e8b.png] 

The logic followed here is,

For RXPL is related to OUMI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c1e2397c1533516f680ecf758e5c494d83e05c0bfc67fc1b5253033ac99e639.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eae2faace1acdf6d573d921cd6495ba14a29dc4fb8839c40d820aff3cfdf463c.png]

Similarly, for PVNJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5a3c81206059cea6425801d370a23176eaa112075c959de8a807974065a205d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9190a02ac520e1cf0ae15a62de8397ad94049b432a3fc070c446b44c1774de17.png]

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
